Week 22: Tallinn Valencia Hackathon

IWER

This week I tried to use babylon.js to make a webXR school campus tour. Many experiences I have mentioned in the previous post.

Hackathon

During 21-22, I was attending a hackathon hold by Garage 48. It was a great chance to practically use the knowledge I learned about LLMs. I made a simple RAG system using Gemini to suggest restaurants. Why Gemini, because I just found out that I was my microsoft account was regulated by the AI regulation law in mainland China. This accident made me realize that a universal tool like langchain is important. The Gemini API is nothing alike the OpenAI API.
